findings.title: Current successor-clause evidence is not rechecked by validate/export
findings.setup: Copied reg-lfmn and successor reg-lic-calidad canonical JSON into private root; other corpus directories are read-only symlinks. Replaced only the private successor Segundo text after validating the unmodified baseline.
findings.expected: Validation must reject a persisted repeal notice whose exact source-bound successor clause hash and quoted abrogation note no longer match the current successor corpus.

actual.before_output: validation: valid; 118 articles, 4 transitories, 16 references, 2 issues
actual.after_output: validation: valid; 118 articles, 4 transitories, 16 references, 2 issues
actual.private_replacement_text: Cláusula de prueba sin abrogación del reglamento anterior.

findings.cause: The live clause/header guard validate_repeal_config runs during parse only. read_corpus/core validation checks notice shape, predecessor hash and status but never checks the current successor corpus. run_validate and run_export bypass the evidence-basis guard.
findings.fix_suggestion: Create a shared canonical-notice evidence check invoked by validation and publication as well as parse. For successor-basis notices, resolve exact current successor ID/provision/hash/quote; fail before publication or mutation on drift/missing target. Keep parse-only acquisition/header checks distinct when retained raw bytes are unavailable.
findings.scope_limit: No mismatch found in the actual committed reg-lfmn successor clause; this is a confirmed drift-detection defect using a private mutation.

findings.title: Reparse warns about stale lawyer-verified evidence then overwrites its canonical applied state
findings.setup: Canonical LRITF provisions serialized back into parseable source; only reviewed Séptima text adds a synthetic suffix. Private source_format=html bypasses unavailablePDF furniture audit. No officialsource or maincorpus changed.
findings.expected: Ordinary reparse must stop before canonical writes when it would clear or replace a lawyer-verified decision due to changed/missing evidence, pending an explicit reviewed migration. Never reapply the old decision onto changed text.
findings.cause: reapply_temporal_determinations correctly identifies nonmatching evidence as stale, but the CLI only warns and returns Ok, allowing run_parse to write freshly parsed unanalyzed states over the existing applied human decision.
findings.fix_suggestion: Before any canonical write, fail closed if a stale/missing determination has LawyerVerified basis or would remove an existing audited state. Preserve old records/canonical state for review; any stale-state migration must be explicit and audited.
findings.scope_limit: The prior temporal-result/review sidecars remain intact; the demonstrated loss is the applied canonical review status, dates and effects. Synthetic reconstruction omits reform appendix, causing eight additional machine determinations to be stale; the single altered human-reviewed Séptima independently demonstrates the defect.
